globalSearch-instructions-description: Hwehwɛes can include operatanaas kɔ refine no search.  Operatanaas are specified denam writing no operatanaa din ne value separated denam a colon.  Fanaa example, an operatanaa specification a `nhyehyɛe:Blocked` would limit no search kɔ kaads that are contained wɔ a nhyehyɛe dind *Blocked*.  If no value contains spaces anaa special characters it must be enclosed wɔ quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kaads wɔ bɔɔds matching no specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - kaads wɔ nhyehyɛes matching no specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - kaads wɔ kwans matching no specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaads that have a label matching *<color>* anaa *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - kaads where *<username>* is no kaad's creatanaa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaads belonging kɔ a bɔɔd assigned kɔ anaaganization *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaads belonging kɔ a bɔɔd assigned kɔ team *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaads which are due up kɔ *<n>* days fi now.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ nhyehyɛes all kaads past noir due date.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaads which were yɛɛ *<n>* days ago anaa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaads which were modified *<n>* days ago anaa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - where *<status>* is one a no following:
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - kaads nko ara wɔ public bɔɔds
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - kaads nko ara wɔ private bɔɔds
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* is one a `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` anaa `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` wɔ front a *<field>* searches fanaa no absence a a value wɔ that field (e.g. `has:-due` searches fanaa kaads neout a due date).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* is one a `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` anaa `__predicate_modified__`.  Fanaa a descending sanaat, place a `-` wɔ front a no sanaat din.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - where *<n>* is a positive integer expressing no number a kaads kɔ be displayed per page.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operatanaas are *OR*ed togenor.  Kaads that match any a no conditions will be returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` would return kaads contained wɔ any nhyehyɛe dind *Blocked* anaa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operatanaas are *AND*ed togenor.  Nko ara kaads that match all a no differing operatanaas are returned.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns nko ara kaads wɔ no nhyehyɛe *Available* ne a *red* label.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Das can be specified as a positive anaa negative integer anaa using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` anaa `__predicate_year__` fanaa no current period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu no mfa nkyerɛwde akɛse ne nketewa nsonsonoe nyɛ adwuma.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: By default archived kaads are not searched.
